tools.name: search_help
tools.description: Search the Bookatu help centre, the plain-language guides to every feature, in any of its 14 languages. Returns the guides that match, closest first, with their summary, page, markdown copy and the dashboard screen each is set up on.

tools.name: get_help_article
tools.description: Get one help guide in full by its slug: what the feature is, why it helps and the real steps to use it, in the language asked for, with its page and its dashboard screen.

tools.name: search_blog
tools.description: Search the Bookatu blog for business owners (a translated post in the language asked for), or the engineering blog with section "engineering". Returns the posts that match, closest first, with their excerpt, date, page and markdown copy.

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: Get one blog or engineering post in full by its slug, as markdown, with its author, dates, tags and page.

tools.name: search_developer_docs
tools.description: Search the Bookatu developer docs: every REST endpoint, the webhooks and their events, the MCP servers and their tools, and the guides (authentication, CORS, rate limits). Returns the parts that match, closest first, with a short snippet, their place on /developers and the markdown copy.

tools.name: get_plans
tools.description: Get what Bookatu costs, as the pricing page states it: each plan's monthly price, billed monthly and billed yearly, each plan and add-on price in every currency and which currency a business is charged in, how many active clients it covers, the commission, the optional add-ons, the length of the tri

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "docs" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_blog, get_blog_post · Public sink: search_blog, get_blog_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_blog, get_blog_post · Public sink: search_blog, get_blog_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_plans" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get what Bookatu costs, as the pricing page states it: each plan's monthly price, billed monthly and billed yearly, how many active clients it covers, the commission, the optional add-ons, the length of the trial and the currency. Takes no arguments." → after: "Get what Bookatu costs, as the pricing page states it: each plan's monthly price, billed monthly and billed yearly, each plan and add-on price in every currency and which currency a business is charged in, how many active clients it covers, the commission, the optional add-ons, the length of the tri"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
